_comment: THE KILN'S SECOND RECIPE, and the only Breeze Rod in the game (#278).
A Breeze Rod drops only from a Breeze, a Breeze spawns only from a trial spawner inside a
trial chamber, and this world opts into exactly three structures - nether fortress, bastion
remnant and the mod's own sewer. No breeze can spawn here at all, so the rod, the Wind Charge
and everything downstream had no source.
Sintering is the honest verb: hold a pressed compact below its melting point until the
particles fuse into a solid. A propellant grain is made exactly that way, which is why this
is the same machine and the same shape as the blaze chain rather than a new mechanic.
WHAT IT UNLOCKS, stated honestly because #278 records the case as thin: Wind Charges, at
vanilla's four per rod, and Ender IO's Concentrated Cloud Seed. NOT the Mace - that also
needs a Heavy Core, which comes only from an ominous vault and is still absent - and not the
flow armour trim, whose template is trial chamber loot.
Time and experience mirror the blaze recipe; #36 owns them.
